notes: ACCESS: plain HTTP fetch via curl_cffi, no WAF encountered. DISCOVERY: the header mega-menu has a dedicated 'New Arrivals' section (under a broader 'New + Featured' hub tile) exposing genuine site-defined children: View All (-> new-arrivals-view-all), Furniture, Outdoor, Workspace, Lighting, Storage, Kitchen + Dining, Bed + Bath, Rugs, Decor - each its own SFCC category page/URL with its own rendered header count and matching data-product-count attribute (all cross-checked and equal for every one of the 10 pages). 'new-arrivals-view-all' (H1 'All New Arrivals', 478 results) is the genuine complete/undifferentiated listing and was used as the parent/group row; the 9 department pages are true site-exposed children (real distinct URLs reachable from the mega-menu, not facet re-cuts of a single page), so a grouping row + leaves structure was emitted per the shared engine's rules. Overlap note: the 9 children sum to 566, which exceeds the 478-item parent listing - this is expected overlap (a product recurring across e.g. both 'Furniture' and 'Outdoor' new-arrivals views), the same pattern already documented for this exact site in the prior Home-Decor pass notes (parent counts there also didn't equal sums of overlapping room-based children) - not treated as an error. EXCLUDED CANDIDATES: 'newarrivals' (the mega-menu's landing/hub URL, H1 'New Arrivals') and 'new-featured' (H1 'New + Featured') were both opened and confirmed to be pure editorial/navigation landing pages with no product grid, no data-product-count, no grid-tile markup at all - excluded as non-PLP hub pages per brief SS3/SS5, since their real listings (View All + the 9 departments) are already captured directly. Checked header mega-menu, footer, and homepage promo tiles; did not use the site's own /search endpoint (robots.txt disallows */search).
